measure.measure_definition: NREM slow-oscillation EEG spectral power (0.5 to <1 Hz), evaluated for acute nights 1–2 and chronic nights 29–30. Primary spectral analyses used mean relative power averaged across frontal F3/F4 derivations and both nights at each visit after EEG quality control. The report evaluates log-transformed power-ratio differences from acute to chronic exposure; within-arm one-sample t tests assess deviation from zero.

The report evaluates log-transformed power-ratio differences from acute to chronic exposure; within-arm one-sample t tests assess deviation from zero.

population.population_definition: Selection into the EEG analysis subsample from the SUNRISE 1 parent trial.; Randomized subsample of 249 participants selected from 450 eligible participants to balance sex (male:female ratio) and race (White/Black representation); selected from the middle two quartiles (25th–75th percentile) of baseline composite memory scores on the Performance Assessment Battery; restricted baseline ISI range 13–28; stratified by baseline PSG total sleep time ≤6 h vs >6 h; all selected participants met ≥80% pill-count adherence during the 30-day treatment period.

population.population_definition: Availability of adequate-quality NREM sleep EEG data for reliable quantitative analysis at all visits.; Participants from the 249-participant EEG subsample with EEG data of adequate quality for reliable quantitative analysis at all visits in NREM sleep; NREM sample included 126 female; mean age 71.77 ± 0.37 years; NREM and REM analytic samples partially overlapping because REM data were more frequently excluded for artifact contamination.

result.comparison: Within P5: chronic relative to acute exposure, tested against zero; positive values indicate increased effects with prolonged exposure, negative values decreased effects (source wording)
result.statistic_type: Within-arm one-sample t statistic for the reported chronic-to-acute log-transformed power-ratio change
result.statistical_method: One-sample t-test against zero with LSD adjustments. The methods define acute and chronic proportional changes as (Acute - Baseline)/Baseline and (Chronic - Baseline)/Baseline and apply log10(1 + ratio). The reported chronic-to-acute change assesses evolving effects; the Results state that positive values indicate increased effects with prolonged exposure and negative values decreased effects. The exact composite chronic-to-acute formula is not separately printed. Per-test n is not explicitly reported. The dedicated one-sample test paragraph specifies LSD; the separate general Bonferroni statement is retained as a source-wording conflict.
result.supplementary_statistics: p=.01; Cohen's d=0.45; df=34; this is not a between-arm test
